newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emery opens Middle East office in Dubai.
newsitem.headline: Emery opens Middle East office in Dubai.

text.p: Integrator Emery Worldwide has set up a Middle East regional office in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates, its Middle East manager Rod Cox said on Thursday.

"Emery Worldwide has been represented in the Middle East for some time and has been part of the Africa division. In order to give it more focus, we have split the division and made it an entity of its own," he told Reuters.
The office, which is staffed with five people, started operating earlier this month.
Cox said the office would link Emery and its Middle East partners and will handle administration and customer relations in the region.
"The Middle East is strategically important to Emery Worldwide, particularly the United Arab Emirates as it is a gateway between Asia and Europe," he added.
Emery is a division of Consolidated Freightways Inc.
